text: そうか　わすれさせたい　わざが　あったら　また　きてよ

structure.jp: わすれさせたい　わざが　あったら
structure.en: if there's a move you want forgotten

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' or 'when' that happens. あったら = 'if there is one'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb means 'want to do'. Here it sits on わすれさせる 'make forget' and describes the move after it. わすれさせたい わざ = 'a move you want to make it forget'.

patterns.name: 〜てください
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb on its own is a casual request, the short form of てください. きてよ = 'come by, okay'.
